accepts.because: a first turn from a surface, for somebody this colony has not met yet. The caller MUST promote the identity to context.channel

emits.because: the greeting, or the handover for whoever takes over the conversation
the tree this reception decided to grow, as an ordinary mutation body. BOOTSTRAP ONLY -- no mutation can create the edge that carries it on to /colony/mutations

description.purpose: Scope marker of the reception: it holds the channel register and the one pass that reads it, behind a single entry lane. Everything that arrives from a surface goes through here exactly once per turn, and leaves on the lane of the channel it belongs to.
description.use_when: One per colony that serves more than one channel through the same kind of agent. Instantiate it in the same mutation that wires the ingress lane -- and grant the mutation lane in the parent's bootstrap config.json, because no mutation can create it.
description.not_in_scope: No conversation, no routing table of its own: the per-channel lanes are edges the reception itself draws, and they live in the parent scope's edge table like every other edge. Nothing is deleted -- a channel that fell silent keeps its row and its talky.
